Clarifications (no doubt on the row): 00658470 also wraps the 0060D4F0 chain in a 005DC190(stack, r8, 0) object released by 0016D6A0, and its 0060B980 call takes qword rcx+0x50 as second argument and a record {008C6C98, qword +0x20 of qword rcx+0x50}, then 0, dword rdx+0x220 and byte 0; in 006587F0, 00659A90 and 00659C20 the 0060B980 record is {008C6C98, rcx+0x30} and the remaining arguments are 0, dword rdx+0x220 and byte 0. 006587F0 and 00659C20: each descriptor copy first tests that the destination field address (rcx+0x58 and so on) is non-null and returns 1 if not; that path is reachable only for a near-null rcx, so the rows omit it. 00659C20: 0065D720 also receives the incoming r8 and r9 untouched (the listing sets only rdx = r9). 0018FD70: the 0065A630 call passes the incoming rdx unchanged; the fifth argument is the byte 1.
